description: This file implements telemetry services for the Mattermost Focalboard server, including configuration, telemetry data collection, and integration with Rudder analytics.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Handles telemetry data collection, configuration, and communication with Rudder analytics.

classes.name: RudderConfig
classes.description: Holds configuration details for Rudder integration, including API key and dataplane URL.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new telemetry Service instance with specified ID and logger.

methods.name: RegisterTracker
methods.description: Registers a telemetry data tracker function by name.

methods.name: getRudderConfig
methods.description: Retrieves Rudder configuration from constants or environment variables.

methods.name: sendDailyTelemetry
methods.description: Sends telemetry data daily, with optional override.

methods.name: sendTelemetry
methods.description: Enqueues a telemetry event with properties to Rudder.

methods.name: initRudder
methods.description: Initializes the Rudder client with provided endpoint and API key.

methods.name: doTelemetryIfNeeded
methods.description: Determines whether to send telemetry based on elapsed time since first run and last sent.

methods.name: RunTelemetryJob
methods.description: Starts the recurring telemetry job with initial delay.

methods.name: doTelemetry
methods.description: Performs telemetry sending and updates last sent timestamp.
